newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares ease, Wolford down sharply.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares ease, Wolford down sharply.

text.p: 1430 GMT - Austrian shares lost ground ahead of the long holiday weekend and traders said the ATX index had shifted to a 1,210-1,220 points trading range. Wolford under heavy selling pressure from London and the United States.
* ATX index down 8.24 points, or 0.67 percent, at 1,215.24.
* Top gainer industrial group Radex-Heraklith, still buoyed by strong 1996 earnings released on Wednesday and forecast of further growth in 1997. Its shares up 2.8 pct at 460.45 ats.

* Leading decliner hosiery maker Wolford on market rumours 1996/97 profits may suffer because of high expansion costs. The firm rejected the speculation as baseless. Wolford shares 6.38 pct down at 1,320 ats.
* April ATX future down 9.5 points at 1,218.5
